starMapLighting.title: Star-map Signature Lighting
starMapLighting.description: The striking new bumper and grille bring a strong dose of emotion and confidence to the design, seamlessly connecting with the signature Star Map daytime running lights for an even more impressive overall impression.

ledHeadlights.title: Vertically Shaped LED Headlights
ledHeadlights.description: Illuminate the path ahead with distinct style. The striking vertically shaped LED headlights not only provide superior nighttime visibility but also give the Sportage a bold, futuristic signature look that stands out.

ledTaillights.title: LED Taillights with Star-map
ledTaillights.description: The rear combination lamps with new graphics and the characteristic Star Map design immediately attract attention.

welcomeLight.title: Dynamic Welcome Light
welcomeLight.description: Experience a captivating entrance. The dynamic welcome light sequence greets you with a sophisticated illumination display, setting the tone for your journey before you even step inside.

alloyWheels.title: New design Alloy Wheels
alloyWheels.description: The 19-inch wheels take both performance and design to the next level, delivering the ideal balance between elegance and sportiness.

interior.name: Interior
interior.closingText: Whether you're cruising city streets, travelling the countryside or venturing off the beaten track, the new Kia Sportage delivers balanced performance, optimal fuel economy and a captivating driving experience.

panoramicDisplay.title: Panoramic Dual Curved 12.3" Display
panoramicDisplay.description: 12.3-inch dual panoramic curved screens with an intuitive interface, wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, and real-time navigation.

steeringWheel.title: Double D-Cut Steering Wheel
steeringWheel.description: A sporty, multi-function steering wheel that provides easy access to various controls while adding a touch of sophistication to the interior.

ambientLighting.title: Ambient Lighting
ambientLighting.description: An interior ambient can be customizable by the direct-lighting mood lamp to the lower part of the slim vent in the crash pad.

harmanKardon.title: Premium Harman/Kardon Audio System
harmanKardon.description: Immerse yourself in an exceptional musical experience during every drive. The Harman/Kardon® system features 8 powerful speakers strategically placed throughout the interior, an external amplifier and Active Sound Design (ASD) technology for rich, detailed sound and an unrivaled listening experience.

panoramicSunroof.title: Panoramic Sunroof
panoramicSunroof.description: Full-length panoramic glass roof with electrochromic dimming, flooding the cabin with natural light while maintaining UV protection.

headUpDisplay.title: 10" Head-Up Display
headUpDisplay.description: By projecting key driving information on a 10-inch high-definition head-up display, you can focus more on the road ahead.

surroundViewMonitor.title: Surround View Monitor (SVM)
surroundViewMonitor.description: See it all, from every angle. The Surround View Monitor gives you a 360-degree bird's-eye view of your surroundings – perfect for navigating tight trails or crowded city streets.

multiTerrainMode.title: Multi-Terrain Mode
multiTerrainMode.description: Sportage provides four driving modes, which can be freely switched according to your needs.

allWheelDrive.title: All-Wheel Drive
allWheelDrive.description: The intelligent All-Wheel Drive system continuously adapts to changing conditions, delivering optimal traction and stability to all four wheels, no matter the terrain or weather.

turbocharged.title: 2.0L Turbocharged
turbocharged.description: The 2.0L Turbocharged engine delivers an impressive surge of power and torque, ensuring a dynamic, responsive, and thrilling driving experience on every trip.

closingText: Every road becomes a scenic adventure when you're behind the wheel of the Kia Sportage L, just let it lead the way and enjoy the ride.

forwardCollision.title: Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist 2
forwardCollision.description: FCA 2 monitors the surroundings and automatically assists braking when the risk of collision increases with a vehicle, motorcyclist, pedestrian, or cyclist ahead; with an oncoming vehicle from the opposite side or from the left/right side at an intersection; or with a directly oncoming vehicle in the same lane. It also automatically assists steering when there is a risk of collision with an oncoming vehicle or a vehicle in the next lane while changing lanes, as well as with a vehicle or pedestrian on the edge of the lane.

laneFollowing.title: Lane Following Assist 2
laneFollowing.description: LFA 2 helps center the vehicle in the lane. Steering control has been improved and a Hands-On Detection (HOD) sensor can determine whether the driver is holding the steering wheel for optimal system performance.

blindSpot.title: Blind-spot Collision-avoidance Assist
blindSpot.description: Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist (BCA) warns if a lane departure is detected without the use of a turn signal. It automatically assists with steering to help prevent the vehicle from leaving the lane in such cases.

parkingCollision.title: Parking Collision Avoidance Assist
parkingCollision.description: The Sportage's front, side and rear parking assist feature makes it easier to manoeuvre into and out of parking spaces. It detects pedestrians or obstacles in the area, provides warnings and, if there is an increased risk of collision, applies automatic emergency braking for added protection.

smartCruiseControl.title: Smart Cruise Control 2
smartCruiseControl.description: SCC helps you drive at a preset speed while maintaining a safe distance from the vehicle ahead. It automatically brings the vehicle to a stop then proceeds again when the vehicle ahead accelerates. If the stop is extended, you may need to press the accelerator pedal. When activated, SCC drives automatically, reflecting the learned driving style.

parkingDistanceWarning.title: Parking Distance Warning F/S/R
parkingDistanceWarning.description: The Kia Sportage Parking Distance Warning (PDW) system uses ultrasonic sensors on the bumpers to detect obstacles at low speeds, emitting audible alerts and visual warnings when in reverse or driving slowly.

connectedServices.title: Connected Car Services & Over the Air update
connectedServices.description: Allowing vehicles to receive software enhancements, security patches, and new features remotely via cellular or Wi-Fi, eliminating dealership visits.

digitalKey.title: Digital Key
digitalKey.description: A smartphone-based system allowing users to lock, unlock, and start their Kia vehicle via NFC or UWB technology using a smartphone or smart watch.
